description: NOT REGISTERED. Candidates that change timing or looks; each needs the browser check named in its note.

patches.repl:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://api.mapbox.com" crossorigin />
  <link rel="prefetch" as="script" href="/assets/{{ENTRY}}" crossorigin />
patches.note: NEEDS BROWSER VERIFICATION (E2): warms the HTTP cache with the 657 KB (br) entry at idle priority while the splash is shown, so import() after FCP does not wait for the download. Risk: it shares the link with the two media=print stylesheets that the loader waits for (3 s cap) and could delay the boot instead; drop it if FCP, LCP or time-to-interactive regress on a throttled run

patches.repl: <title>Gettysburg Interactive Battle Map — Animated Map of July 1–3, 1863</title>
patches.note: OWNER DECISION (brand wording of the home title; og:title and twitter:title stay the brand name). Puts "Interactive Battle Map" (the words of the domain and of the target queries) into the one tag Google weighs most for the page. verify_release V6 then lists one identity difference: index.html: title changed "Gettysburg Animated Battlefield Map" -> "Gettysburg Interactive Battle Map — Animated Map of July 1–3, 1863"
